# Cooling Expert
Cooling Expert is an AC repair, servicing and installation business based in Hafeez Baba Nagar, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Owner: Mohd Faisal.

## Proof
- 12 years of AC work (2014-2026)
- Approximately 9,750 jobs completed
- 5,500+ AC installations/dismantlings
- LG installation: 1,200 units
- Daikin installation: 800 units
- Other listed brands: 3,500 units
- Deep servicing: 3,000 jobs
- Gas charging/leak repair: 1,250 jobs

## Services
AC repair, installation, jet pump deep service, gas charging and leak repair, copper piping, PCB repair, AMC and commercial/mall AC installation.

## Coverage
Hyderabad and all over Telangana, including Warangal, Karimnagar, Nizamabad, Khammam, Nalgonda, Mahbubnagar, Ramagundam, Siddipet and Adilabad.
